_comment: The packaged configurations a fresh install can adopt in one press. This file is the AUTHORITY; the setup_picks table is its loaded copy (express_setup.load_packaged, run at every start). Edit here, commit, restart. No ':free' models on purpose: free tiers have spotty-to-no support, and a model that stops answering is the opposite of a bullet-proof setup. A user can pick anything else by hand once the box is running.

picks.label: DeepSeek · Flash
picks.why: The best all-round model we have tested: strong writing, fast, long context, inexpensive. It is the one this app expects.
picks.verified_how: Was listed by DeepSeek's own API and accepted as the default on a fresh install, with both reporters seeded from it. No chat turn had been driven on that install when this was written.

picks.label: OpenRouter · DeepSeek Flash
picks.why: The same family as the DeepSeek model, through OpenRouter — one key also opens every other model that service offers, if you want to try them later.
picks.verified_how: Appears in the app's own curated model list with its price and context length. Not yet driven end to end.

picks.label: OpenRouter · Qwen 3.7 Flash
picks.why: The long-context workhorse: 1M tokens of context at about three cents a million. A sound second choice.
picks.verified_how: Appears in the app's own curated model list with its price and context length. Not yet driven end to end.

picks.label: OpenRouter · GPT-OSS 120B
picks.why: OpenAI's open 120B — inexpensive and capable, and a different family to fall back on if DeepSeek ever lets you down.
picks.verified_how: Appears in the app's own curated model list with its price and context length. Not yet driven end to end.

picks.label: Ollama Cloud · Nemotron 3 Super
picks.why: A large reasoning model on a keyed service, for anyone already using Ollama Cloud. Its free usage is metered, so treat it as a stopgap.
picks.verified_how: Appears in the app's own curated model list. Not yet driven end to end.
